subScenes.name: 破冰寒暄
subScenes.description: 在咖啡馆初遇，用轻松话题打破沉默，建立初步舒适感。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：轻松开启话题

followUps.text: Pretty good! I finally caught up on sleep and went hiking on Saturday.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错！我终于补足了觉，周六去徒步了。

followUps.text: It was pretty busy, but I’m glad it’s over.
followUps.text_cn: 挺忙的，不过总算熬过去了。

followUps.text: To be honest, I was just scrolling through my phone most days… but I’m hoping this weekend’s better!
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我这几天 mostly 在刷手机……但希望这周末能好点！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于约会初期破冰，回应对方对近况的关心，避免只说 'Fine'，展示个性和开放性

qaPairs.triggerText: What do you usually do on weekends?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你平时周末都做些什么？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：探索共同兴趣

followUps.text: I love trying new coffee shops—I’ve been on a quest to find the best latte in town!
followUps.text_cn: 我喜欢尝试新开的咖啡店，最近在找城里最好喝的拿铁！

followUps.text: Honestly? I’m more of a stay-at-home person—I binge-watch shows and cook simple meals.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我更喜欢宅家，追剧+做点简单的饭。

followUps.text: I’m still figuring that out—I just moved here, so I’m exploring places one at a time.
followUps.text_cn: 我还在摸索中，刚搬来这儿，正一个地方一个地方地探索。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应关于周末习惯的问题，避免笼统回答，用具体细节促进互动

qaPairs.triggerText: So, how do you know [mutual friend's name]?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 那你认识[共同朋友的名字]是怎么认识的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：通过共同联系人切入

followUps.text: We worked together at the same startup—she introduced us at a team dinner!
followUps.text_cn: 我们以前在同一家初创公司上班——她是在一次团队聚餐时介绍我们认识的！

followUps.text: Actually, we met through a hiking group—I didn’t even know she was your friend until now!
followUps.text_cn: 其实我是通过一个徒步群认识她的——我直到现在才知道她是你朋友！

followUps.text: I’ve only met her once at a party—I’m actually a bit nervous we’re hanging out now!
followUps.text_cn: 我只在一次派对上见过她一次——其实我现在还有点紧张我们俩居然约了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应关于共同认识的人的问题，展示社交背景，避免简单回答 'We’re coworkers' 而缺乏细节

subScenes.name: 寻找共鸣
subScenes.description: 通过开放式问题发现共同兴趣，自然延伸对话内容。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you ever just binge-watch shows on weekends?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你周末会一口气追剧吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中寻找共同兴趣，建立情感共鸣

followUps.text: Absolutely! Last weekend I finished an entire season of Stranger Things—no shame.
followUps.text_cn: 当然会！上周末我一口气看完了《怪奇物语》一整季，毫不羞愧。

followUps.text: Not really—I’m more into hiking or reading, but I envy people who can binge-watch.
followUps.text_cn: 不太会，我更喜欢徒步或读书，但挺羡慕能一口气追剧的人。

followUps.text: I used to, but now I’m too busy with work—still dream about it though!
followUps.text_cn: 以前会，但现在工作太忙了，不过还是挺想再这样放松的！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于在约会中通过共同爱好建立情感连接，回应时可选择认同、委婉差异或遗憾式共鸣，避免直接否定以维持氛围。

qaPairs.triggerText: What’s your favorite way to unwind after a long week?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你一周忙完后最喜欢怎么放松？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中探索生活方式的相似性，寻找共鸣点

followUps.text: Coffee and a playlist—I’ll sit by the window and just zone out for an hour.
followUps.text_cn: 一杯咖啡加个歌单，我会靠在窗边发呆一小时。

followUps.text: I go out with friends—bars, karaoke, anything loud and fun!
followUps.text_cn: 我会和朋友出去玩——酒吧、KTV，越吵越开心！

followUps.text: Honestly? I nap. No fancy stuff—just sleep until my phone buzzes.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我睡觉。没那么讲究，就是躺到手机响为止。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应此类问题时，选择符合自身真实习惯的放松方式，能自然引发对方分享，促进双向共鸣。避免过度修饰或虚假回答。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you believe in fate, or do you think we make our own paths?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你相信命运，还是觉得人生是自己走出来的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中探讨价值观，深化情感连接

followUps.text: I think it’s both—some things are meant to happen, but you still have to show up for them.
followUps.text_cn: 我觉得两者都有：有些事是注定的，但你仍需主动去迎接。

followUps.text: I’m all about making my own path—I don’t wait for luck, I create opportunities.
followUps.text_cn: 我坚信自己创造人生，从不等运气，而是主动创造机会。

followUps.text: I used to believe in fate, but after a few big surprises, now I’m not sure anymore…
followUps.text_cn: 我以前信命运，但经历几件大事后，现在有点动摇了……

qaPairs.usageNote: 此类哲学性问题常出现在约会中后期，回应时避免非黑即白，适度留白或分享个人转变，能有效拉近心理距离。

subScenes.name: 表达兴趣
subScenes.description: 礼貌回应对方分享，用非语言和语言信号表达欣赏与关注。

qaPairs.triggerText: I really enjoyed our conversation tonight — what do you like to do on weekends?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很喜欢今晚的聊天——你周末通常做什么？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中对方表达兴趣并询问你的休闲习惯，试探共同爱好

followUps.text: I love hiking on weekends — there’s a great trail just outside the city. Want to join me sometime?
followUps.text_cn: 我周末喜欢徒步，城外有一条很棒的步道。改天要不要一起去？

followUps.text: I’m mostly into staying in and watching movies, but I’m open to trying new things!
followUps.text_cn: 我平时 mostly 待在家里看电影，不过我也愿意尝试新活动！

followUps.text: Actually, I’ve been super busy with work lately — but I’d love to hear what you like to do!
followUps.text_cn: 其实最近工作特别忙，不过我很想听听你喜欢做什么！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方表达兴趣并询问你的生活方式时，回应可体现你的态度：主动邀约、温和开放、或委婉转移焦点。避免只说‘还行’或‘不知道’，这会冷场。

qaPairs.triggerText: You seem really passionate about photography — what got you into it?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你看起来对摄影特别有热情——是什么让你开始喜欢的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方注意到你的兴趣并深入提问，表达欣赏与好奇

followUps.text: I started when I traveled to Japan — the light and colors were unforgettable. I’d love to show you some of my photos!
followUps.text_cn: 我是在去日本旅行时开始的，那里的光影太难忘了。我很想给你看看我的一些照片！

followUps.text: It’s kind of a hobby I picked up to de-stress — not super serious, but it’s become my thing.
followUps.text_cn: 这算是我用来减压的小爱好，不算专业，但已经成了我的习惯。

followUps.text: I’m actually just getting started — I’m still learning. Do you take photos too?
followUps.text_cn: 我其实才刚开始学，还在摸索中。你也拍照吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方对你某项爱好表示兴趣时，回应应体现真诚与开放。避免简单回答‘嗯，还行’，而应加入细节或反问，推动互动。

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve been thinking — would you be open to grabbing coffee next week?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我一直在想，你愿意下周一起喝杯咖啡吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方直接提出进一步约会邀请，试探你的意愿

followUps.text: That sounds perfect! I’m free Thursday afternoon — how about 3 PM?
followUps.text_cn: 听起来太棒了！我周四下午有空，三点怎么样？

followUps.text: I’d love to, but I’m swamped next week — could we try the week after?
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但下周太忙了，我们能安排再下周吗？

followUps.text: I’m not sure yet — I’ve got a few things to sort out. Can I get back to you by Friday?
followUps.text_cn: 我还不确定，有点事要处理。我周五前回复你行吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 面对直接邀约，回应需体现真实态度：接受、延迟或婉拒。避免模棱两可的‘maybe’，应给出清晰但礼貌的反馈，维持关系张力。

subScenes.name: 邀约下一次
subScenes.description: 基于对话内容，自然提出下次见面建议，保持轻松不压迫。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to grab coffee next week?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 下周要不要一起喝杯咖啡？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会后邀约下一次见面，对方提出模糊时间建议

followUps.text: Sure! How about Wednesday afternoon?
followUps.text_cn: 当然！周三下午怎么样？

followUps.text: I'm pretty busy next week, but maybe the week after?
followUps.text_cn: 下周我挺忙的，但后周可以？

followUps.text: I'd love to, but let me check my schedule and get back to you?
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但我得先查一下日程再回复你？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于约会后自然推进下次见面，回应时需体现态度与灵活性，避免生硬拒绝或过度承诺

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you have fun tonight? Maybe we could do this again soon?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今晚玩得开心吗？我们改天再约一次？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会结束时对方表达满意并主动提议再次见面

followUps.text: Absolutely! I loved it — how about a picnic this weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 当然！我超喜欢的——这周末去野餐怎么样？

followUps.text: I had a great time, but I'm not sure I'm ready for another date yet.
followUps.text_cn: 我玩得很开心，但我还不确定是不是准备好再约一次了。

followUps.text: Definitely! Let’s plan something active — maybe hiking?
followUps.text_cn: 一定！我们计划点运动的吧——比如徒步？

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应时需平衡真诚与边界感，避免因过度热情或冷淡影响关系发展

qaPairs.triggerText: I really enjoyed our chat — want to meet up again sometime?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很享受我们的聊天，想再约一次吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 非正式场合（如聚会后）对方提出模糊邀约，未指定时间

followUps.text: Yes! Text me when you're free next week?
followUps.text_cn: 好啊！下周你有空时发我消息？

followUps.text: I'm not really looking to date right now, but I'd love to stay friends.
followUps.text_cn: 我现在不太想谈恋爱，但很乐意保持朋友关系。

followUps.text: I'm curious — what kind of thing did you have in mind?
followUps.text_cn: 我很感兴趣——你心里有想做什么吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于模糊邀约场景，回应需清晰表达意图，避免暧昧造成误解

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 结束约会时表达感谢，留下积极印象，为未来联系留空间。

qaPairs.triggerText: This has been such a nice evening, thanks for coming out with me.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今晚真的很愉快，谢谢你出来和我约会。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会结束时，对方表达感谢并暗示结束

followUps.text: I had a great time too—I’d love to do this again soon!
followUps.text_cn: 我也玩得很开心！希望很快能再约一次！

followUps.text: Thanks, it was really nice meeting you. I should head out now, but have a great night!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，和你见面很开心。我得走了，祝你今晚愉快！

followUps.text: I really enjoyed it! Can I text you tomorrow to see if you’re free next weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很享受今晚！我可以明天发消息问问你下周末有空吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于约会结束时回应对方的感谢，根据你对对方的好感程度选择不同回应：热情、礼貌收尾、或主动推进关系。

qaPairs.triggerText: I should probably get going—it’s getting late.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方以时间晚为由暗示告别

followUps.text: Totally understand—let me walk you to the car?
followUps.text_cn: 完全理解，我送你到车边吧？

followUps.text: Yeah, it’s been a long day. Thanks for tonight—it meant a lot.
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，今天确实挺累的。谢谢你今晚的陪伴，这对我很重要。

followUps.text: Same here! Let’s plan something for next week—I’ve got your number, right?
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！我们下周再约吧？我有你号码，对吧？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方以‘时间晚’为由告别时，回应可体现体贴、情感或主动，避免冷淡或敷衍。

qaPairs.triggerText: I had a wonderful time, but I’ve got an early start tomorrow.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我过得很开心，但我明天要早起。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方表达好感但因日程限制必须离开

followUps.text: Of course, rest up! I’ll message you next week—this wasn’t the last time, I hope.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，好好休息！我下周发消息给你——希望这不是最后一次。

followUps.text: Same here—I’m already looking forward to the next one!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！我已经开始期待下一次了！

followUps.text: No worries—I totally get it. Have a good night!
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，我完全理解。晚安！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方因日程限制告别时，回应需平衡礼貌与情感表达，避免让对方感到压力或冷漠。
